name: dimecoin
status: BasicSwap does NOT yet support DIME (it supports DASH). Enabling DIME needs an upstream coin-interface PR to tecnovert/basicswap (or particl/basicswap): add a Coins.DIME enum in basicswap/util.py, create basicswap/interface/dimecoin/chainparams.py with the params above (Dimecoin-specific tx version 2 + strTxComment handling, not a plain DASH clone), and register it in basicswap/chainparams.py. This file is the chainparams reference for that PR. DIME has no registered SLIP-44 coin type, so bip44 is intentionally omitted - add it only after DIME is registered with SLIP-44.
note_rpcport: rpcport 8332 is the Dimecoin node's real default RPC port (src/chainparamsbase.cpp:36).
